summary: The change adds docs/design/reviews/decision-sets-review-1.md and a CHANGELOG entry, and touches nothing else (git status and git diff --stat). The review treats both designs as one system. Section 1 is a fit table covering the four parts. It checks claims against code with line numbers, and every spot-check I made matched: defaults.rs deny_unknown_fields at lines 7 and 16, the budgets at lib.rs 157-159, the gh.rs merge call at line 485, OutcomeState::Rejected at run.rs 925 and 1042, the briefs.rs heading at line 158, ensure_changelog at reading.rs 93, 91 `## D` headings, D87's "cannot stop a user" line, and the only HTTP 405 mention being in D91.
